en_title: AI-Fueled Game Development Just Needs a Toy Story-Style Hit to Be Accepted, Former Take-Two CEO Says
cn_title: Take-Two前CEO称，AI驱动的游戏开发只需一部《玩具总动员》式的佳作就能被接受
opus_summary: Take-Two前CEO Ben Feder认为，一款出色的AI生成游戏将消除玩家的抵触情绪，让西方消费者接受游戏中的AI技术；他称东方消费者已经接受。现任CEO Strauss Zelnick则表示，AI是有价值的工具，但人类仍将是公司业务的核心。

paragraphs.en: Audiences will learn to love AI-generated games, the former CEO of GTA publisher Take-Two Interactive has said — as soon as they churn out a 'Toy Story moment' of quality.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA》发行商Take-Two Interactive的前CEO表示，受众将会逐渐爱上AI生成的游戏——只要这类游戏能产出一款品质达到「《玩具总动员》时刻」的作品。

paragraphs.en: Speaking to The Game Business , ex-Take-Two exec Ben Feder claimed that gamers who are sceptical about AI-made slop would be won over when a great example eventually comes along, with any resistance then melting away. Feder served at the company behind releases such as BioShock and Borderlands from 2007 to 2011, before subsequently joining Tencent Games, and serving on the boards of numerous other companies such as Bad Robot and Epic Games.
paragraphs.cn: 前Take-Two高管Ben Feder在接受The Game Business采访时声称，当一款出色的作品最终出现时，对AI制作的粗制滥造之作持怀疑态度的玩家就会被打动，任何抵触情绪届时都会消融。Feder于2007年至2011年在这家发行过《BioShock》和《无主之地》等作品的公司任职，随后加入Tencent Games，并在Bad Robot和Epic Games等众多其他公司的董事会任职。

paragraphs.en: The comparison with Toy Story here is Feder equating the rise of generative AI (replacing games designed and coded by humans) to the emergence of computer animation in the world of animated movies (largely replacing hand-drawn techniques).
paragraphs.cn: Feder在此与《玩具总动员》作比较，是将生成式AI的兴起（取代由人类设计和编写代码的游戏）等同于计算机动画在动画电影界的出现（在很大程度上取代手绘技术）。

paragraphs.en: "When animation went from hand-drawn to computer animation, there was a massive wall of resistance," Feder told The Game Business . "People didn't think it looked good. Then Pixar launched Toy Story. They created a movie that not only was awesome, but used computer-generated animation and chose a subject matter that made the most of it, and did an amazing job with it.
paragraphs.cn: Feder对The Game Business说：「当动画从手绘转向计算机动画时，遭遇了巨大的阻力。人们觉得它看起来不好。然后Pixar推出了《玩具总动员》。他们创作了一部不仅非常出色的电影，还使用了计算机生成动画，选择了一个能够充分发挥这种技术优势的题材，并且做得非常出色。

paragraphs.en: "My own view is that we are one Toy Story moment away from consumer acceptance of AI in video games in the West," Feder continued. "In the East, they've already accepted it."
paragraphs.cn: Feder继续说道：「我个人认为，距离西方消费者接受电子游戏中的AI，我们只差一个《玩具总动员》时刻。在东方，他们已经接受了它。」

paragraphs.en: It's easy to see what Feder is implying, although the similarities between the two situations don't feel clear cut. Yes, Disney fans (and employees) were divided on the art of hand-drawn animation being superseded by an all-digital alternative. But the latter still requires considerable human skill to create — even if an artist is now using a stylus on an iPad rather than drawing with ink on paper.
paragraphs.cn: 不难看出Feder的言外之意，尽管这两种情况之间的相似之处似乎并不那么明确。没错，Disney的粉丝（和员工）对于手绘动画艺术被全数字化的替代形式取代一事存在分歧。但创作后者仍然需要相当高超的人类技艺——即便如今艺术家使用的是iPad上的触控笔，而不是用墨水在纸上作画。

paragraphs.en: Comparing this to the vibe-coded future of game development now rapidly bearing down upon us, generated by a few quick prompts and powered by GPU-hogging and potentially copyright-infringing AI tools, and it all seems something quite different.
paragraphs.cn: 将此与如今正迅速向我们逼近的氛围编程游戏开发未来相比——那种开发方式通过几条快速输入的提示词生成内容，由大量占用GPU资源且可能侵犯版权的AI工具驱动——两者似乎完全不同。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps unsurprisingly, Feder is now a managing partner at Tirta Ventures, a venture capital firm that is keen to invest in AI-generated games. "Our gaming backgroundhelps us identify AI-native platforms shaping how people play, create, and transact in digital environments," Tirta's website states.
paragraphs.cn: 或许并不令人意外，Feder如今是Tirta Ventures的管理合伙人，这家风险投资公司热衷于投资AI生成的游戏。Tirta的网站写道：「我们的游戏行业背景帮助我们识别那些正在塑造人们在数字环境中游戏、创作和交易方式的AI原生平台。」

paragraphs.en: The timing of Feder's statement — and his background at Take-Two — is also somewhat ironic, in the wake of Rockstar releasing the masterpiece that is GTA 6 after a decade of development, creating perhaps the biggest monument to game development without the widespread use of AI tools we're ever likely to see.
paragraphs.cn: Feder发表这番言论的时机——以及他在Take-Two的履历——也有些讽刺，因为Rockstar刚刚在十年开发后推出了《GTA6》这部杰作，创造了我们可能见到的、在未广泛使用AI工具的情况下开发游戏的最伟大的丰碑。

paragraphs.en: That's what the former boss of Take-Two thinks about AI, but what does the current boss of Take-Two think about the tech? Last month, Strauss Zelnick said AI is a valuable tool, but insisted humans will remain at the ehart of what the company does.
paragraphs.cn: 以上是Take-Two前掌门人对AI的看法，但Take-Two现任掌门人又如何看待这项技术？上个月，Strauss Zelnick表示，AI是一种有价值的工具，但他坚称人类仍将是公司业务的核心。

paragraphs.en: “One of our division heads has said to his team, ‘You’re not gonna be replaced by AI, but if you’re not careful you’ll be replaced by someone who knows how to use AI,’” Zelnick said . “I’m fond of saying AI is a collection of datasets, compute, and large language models. That’s what it is. And datasets, by definition, are backward looking. That’s all they are. And creativity, at its best, is forward looking. [...]"
paragraphs.cn: Zelnick说：「我们的一位部门负责人曾对他的团队说，『你们不会被AI取代，但如果不小心，就会被懂得如何使用AI的人取代。』我喜欢说，AI是数据集、算力和大语言模型的集合。它就是这样。而数据集按照定义是回顾过去的。它们仅此而已。而创造力在其最佳状态下是面向未来的。……」

paragraphs.en: If you're keen to play the (human-created) GTA 6 this week, IGN has you covered — including the GTA 6 global release times , as well as details on the last-minute PS5 update you'll need to download . In case you missed it, last night we learned the real-life identity of GTA 6's Lucia . And we're now live with our GTA 6 launch blog , which we'll use to fill you in on everything else about the game over the coming hours.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你渴望在本周游玩（由人类创作的）《GTA6》，IGN已经为你准备好了相关内容——包括《GTA6》的全球发售时间，以及你需要下载的最后一刻推出的PS5更新详情。如果你错过了，昨晚我们获悉了《GTA6》中Lucia的现实身份。我们的《GTA6》发售实时博客现已上线，接下来几个小时我们将在其中为你介绍有关这款游戏的其他所有信息。
